verdict.rationale: First-party docs include a dedicated server-side support page (setup/support/serverSide) and a typedoc entry for the NullEngine class. Together these indicate an official engine mode for running scenes and game logic on a server without rendering. The pack gives only the URLs, not their content, so the depth of the headless workflow cannot be confirmed. Missing for 10: substantive doc content describing the NullEngine/server workflow (e.g. physics, loaders, game loop on Node), independent or hands-on corroboration of dedicated-server use.
